limits: All three encodingDesc elements are empty; no explicit complete shape-to-possible-letter relation or complete parallel normalized reading is present in these files. Unicode character names alone do not establish editorial conventions.

A historical readable tradition need not have a unique context-free decoding. Existence of this source does not show that language context alone uniquely recovers all omitted information.
